subject: Post-demo: LumenAI evaluation — milestone slate, owners, and kickoff availability
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@lumenai.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: LumenAI evaluation — milestone slate, owners, and kickoff availability

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single place to track decisions.

What we heard you want to validate in the 30-day evaluation (proposed success criteria)
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 >= 0.86 on the provided holdout set
- Throughput: sustain typical batch workload (avg 60 reqs/min) for peak testing windows
- Latency: p95 end-to-end < 300ms for 1M tokens/day workload (you asked to confirm exact thresholds below)
- Safety/filters: zero high-severity category hits on the safety test suite we ran

Proposed milestone slate & owners (please confirm):
- Kickoff & infra setup (Week 0): Jul 21 — Owners: Marissa (project coordination), Dylan (integration/infra)
- Baseline ingestion + model mapping (Week 1): Jul 22–28 — Owner: Dylan (data schema + S3 permissions)
- Eval runs & metric collection (Week 2): Jul 29–Aug 4 — Owner: Dylan; Priyom to run bias/safety checks
- Performance tuning & cost runbook (Week 3): Aug 5–11 — Owner: Priyom (batching/quantization suggestions), Dylan for perf tuning
- Final readout & decision meeting (Week 4): Aug 12 — Owners: Marissa + LumenAI stakeholders

Weekly check-ins: propose Thursdays 10:00 PT (30 min) starting Jul 23. Please confirm a recurring slot that works for your team.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm acceptance thresholds above or list edits (especially latency p95 target).
2) Share a sample of your anonymized input dataset (<= 50 documents) and the S3 bucket/path we should use, or grant write access for test artifacts.
3) Confirm kickoff availability for Jul 21 or propose alternative next week.

Attachments: LumenAI-eval-plan-v1.xlsx (draft schedule & evaluation matrix), integration-checklist.docx (SE checklist).

I'll hold off on DocuSign NDA until you confirm legal contact; happy to share our template if needed.

Thanks — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-2143

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena@lumenai.com>

Cc: Eval Team <eval-team@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: LumenAI evaluation — milestone slate, owners, and kickoff availability

Marissa — this looks great, thanks for the concise plan. A few quick confirmations and one small tweak: 

- Confirmed success criteria: entity extraction F1 >= 0.86; throughput and safety as listed.
- Tweak: please make latency p95 target explicit — we need p95 < 300ms for our real-time flows at 1M tokens/day.
- Sample data: we can provide 40 anonymized documents by EOD tomorrow; we'll send via our eval-team S3 bucket (details below).
- NDA: our legal team prefers DocuSign. I can loop in Maria (legal@lumenai.com) if you want the signature started.

S3 details (temporary eval bucket): s3://lumenai-eval/temp-share — we will create a read/write prefix for Redwood: /redwood-integration/2027-07

Kickoff: Jul 21 is OK for our core team (Elena + 2 engineers). Please send calendar invite for 30 min to confirm scope.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Product, LumenAI
elena@lumenai.com | +1 212-555-0199
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@lumenai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: LumenAI evaluation — milestone slate, owners, and kickoff availability

Elena / Marissa — short technical checklist and notes ahead of kickoff: 

1) Data format: please confirm newline-delimited JSON with fields {id, text, metadata}. If you have CSV we'll map columns but NDJSON is preferred.
2) S3 perms: grant read/write to aws-account-id 111122223333 and prefix s3://lumenai-eval/redwood-integration/2027-07. We'll only pull the sample and write run artifacts.
3) Model variants: for the baseline run we'll serve the Llama-variant-13B and a quantized 8-bit variant for perf testing. Priyom — can you prepare quantization perf notes?
4) KV cache and session tests: if you intend to test conversational contexts, please provide sample session chains (2–4 turns) so we can exercise prefix caching.

Operational notes:
- We recommend tagging each request with header X-Lumen-Run: <run-id> for traceability in the readout.
- We'll publish a short results dashboard (read-only link) after week 2.

Attachments: integration-checklist.docx (detailed steps); I'll upload the SE runbook to the shared Drive this afternoon.
